snippet.title: Treacherous Trials - Developer Commentary (i made a game no way)
snippet.description:
I made a game!!! Treacherous Trials is a short puzzle platformer made in ten days for fellow friend and artist @SeaBunCity's birthday. It's based on her cool personifications and lore for the Geometry Dash level Nine Circles! 

Play it here: https://gdcolon.itch.io/treacheroustrials

(in case it's not obvious I am NOT good at unscripted content, I sorta just rambled and cut out any parts where I totally lost my train of thought. apologies for any background noise, i'm living in a university dorm now)

----------------------------------------­----------------------------------------­----------------------------------------­-------------

Main Channel: @GDColon 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheRealGDColon
